text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Autumn's first race arrives, and Mejiro
McQueen comfortably places
first in the
Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With each new race she runs, she earns
still greater respect and
admiration.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm shook! You can't take two steps
without seeing McQueen's face on
some
magazine or screen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I never expected to draw quite this much
attention...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's Major McKeen! Can you shake
my hand?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd be happy to. Also, it's "Mejiro
McQueen."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even the whippersnappers know 'er. Ey,
Star Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Really... Can't you stop with the jokes for
even a second?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna cheer real loud for you in the
next race too. Do your best,
Major
McKeen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I definitely have to
win now! Also, it's "Mejiro
McQueen."

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: See you! Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Goodbye now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't say that I am used to these kinds of
interactions. Reputation is
a strange thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Don't tell me you're going to
turn into a jittery mess.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Th-that is definitely not going to happen.
As a member of the
prestigious Mejiro
family, I always carry myself with dignity!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? Well, I don't see why you can't
just jitter out sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Would you please make up your mind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good morning, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, good news! It looks like there
are a ton more people
asking to transfer
into our team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, the applications haven't stopped since
the Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to your efforts, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It would be super amazing if you could
also win the autumn Tenno
Sho. Imagine
winning both spring and fall!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The number of new applicants would be
through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, you're all speaking like I've already
won.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder everyone's so excited.
You're showing no signs of
slowing down!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder everyone's so excited.
You're showing no signs of
slowing down!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since Team Sirius has had
this much attention.
Probably not since the
heyday of the last trainer.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh, we are so back.

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You've got my front-row cheers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your enthusiastic support, everyone. I will be winning the next race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With that being said, let's start today's
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her bold words, McQueen brings
an inspiring amount of
energy to the day's
training session.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at 'er go!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And that's a finish! A flawless win, and you
took the initiative at the
best possible
moment!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And that's a finish! A flawless win, and you
took the initiative at the
best possible
moment!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. At the Takarazuka Kinen,
I failed to seize a good
position and had to
take wide arcs around the turns.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I want to ensure that races go my way, I
need to pay extra attention
to my dash
power and positioning.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho. Mayhaps you will soon be able
to face me, young one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Before you worry about racing me,
perhaps you should try passing the
basic
gate test.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right folks, let's wrap it up here for
today. Be sure to ice those
legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Actually, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm still feeling pretty good, so I'll be
taking another lap.

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then I'm going to go for another one,
too.

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Me too! If McQueen can still do it, so can
we!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hm? Please don't force yourselves...

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's fine! Seeing you run gives us the
power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Goodness. Once more, then.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golly, they make it look easy. Guess I'll spice things up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hey! Hands off the tail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's industrious attitude has
had nothing but good
effects on the team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She very much is the heart and soul of
Team Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Tazuna! You need me?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd like to discuss with
you concerning McQueen.
